description: Allowed 6% annual interest on proprietor capital ₹5,00,000 at financial year end (6% of ₹5,00,000 = ₹30,000)
narration: Being 6% interest on proprietor capital allowed and credited to capital account
explanation: Operating expense to firm, equity increase to owner: Debit Interest on Capital Expense A/c Dr ₹30,000, Credit Capital A/c Cr ₹30,000.

description: Charged 10% annual interest on proprietor total drawings ₹40,000 at year end (10% of ₹40,000 = ₹4,000)
narration: Being 10% interest on drawings charged to proprietor drawings account
explanation: Finance income to firm, equity deduction to owner: Debit Drawings A/c Dr ₹4,000, Credit Interest on Drawings Income A/c Cr ₹4,000.

description: Provided 10% manager's commission on net profit before charging commission (Net profit ₹1,50,000 * 10% = ₹15,000)
narration: Being 10% manager commission provided on net profit before commission
explanation: Accrued Commission: Debit Manager Commission Expense A/c Dr ₹15,000, Credit Outstanding Manager Commission Liability A/c Cr ₹15,000.

description: Provided 10% manager's commission on net profit AFTER charging commission (Net profit ₹1,10,000 * 10/110 = ₹10,000)
narration: Being 10% manager commission provided on net profit after charging commission
explanation: After Commission Formula [Profit * Rate/(100+Rate)]: Debit Manager Commission Expense A/c Dr ₹10,000, Credit Outstanding Commission Liability A/c Cr ₹10,000.

description: Allowed 6% interest on Partner Amit Gupta capital balance ₹6,00,000 (6% of ₹6,00,000 = ₹36,000)
narration: Being 6% interest allowed on Partner Amit Gupta capital balance
explanation: Partnership Interest on Capital: Debit Interest on Partner Capital A/c ₹36,000, Credit Partner Capital A/c ₹36,000.

description: Charged 8% interest on Partner Sumit Gupta drawings balance ₹30,000 (8% of ₹30,000 = ₹2,400)
creditAccount: Interest on Partner Drawings Income Account
narration: Being 8% interest charged on Partner Sumit Gupta drawings
explanation: Partnership Interest on Drawings: Debit Partner Drawings A/c ₹2,400, Credit Interest on Partner Drawings Income A/c ₹2,400.

description: Accrued sales performance bonus commission ₹18,000 payable to Senior Sales Agent Mr. Roy
narration: Being sales performance commission accrued for April
explanation: Accrued Sales Commission: Debit Sales Commission Expense A/c ₹18,000, Credit Outstanding Commission Liability A/c ₹18,000.

description: Transferred Interest on Capital expense ₹30,000 to Profit & Loss Account to close nominal account
narration: Being annual interest on capital transferred to Profit & Loss Account
explanation: Closing Nominal Entry: Debit Profit & Loss A/c ₹30,000, Credit Interest on Capital Expense A/c ₹30,000.

description: Transferred Interest on Drawings income ₹4,000 to Profit & Loss Account at year end
narration: Being annual interest on drawings income transferred to Profit & Loss Account
explanation: Closing Revenue Entry: Debit Interest on Drawings Income A/c ₹4,000, Credit Profit & Loss A/c ₹4,000.

description: Paid outstanding manager commission ₹15,000 by SBI Bank cheque #501908
narration: Being payment of manager commission liability made via bank cheque
explanation: Clearing Liability: Debit Outstanding Manager Commission Liability A/c ₹15,000, Credit SBI Bank A/c ₹15,000.
